items.html: But Parashat Tetzaveh does not speak of the aspect of the judgments themselves, but of the aspect of what the female takes from the male. For at first, while she is still receiving from him, they are hard judgments; and at her end, when she already has nothing to receive, they are calm. And here it speaks only of the aspect of the female herself who receives the judgments, and not of the aspect of the judgments themselves.
